description: AWS Well-Architected RAG Evaluation Benchmark — 15 in-domain + 5 out-of-domain questions

questions.query: What best practices does the Security pillar specify for IAM root user credentials and MFA enforcement?
How should organizations manage AWS KMS keys and enforce encryption for data at rest according to the Well-Architected Framework?
What detective controls and threat detection services does the Security pillar recommend for incident response?
What are the foundational design principles of the Reliability pillar in the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
How does the Reliability pillar recommend implementing automated recovery and backup strategies for workloads?
What guidance does the Reliability pillar provide for managing service quotas and AWS service limits?
How does the Performance Efficiency pillar guide the selection of the right compute resource type for a workload?
What caching strategies and architectures does the Performance Efficiency pillar recommend to reduce latency?
How does the Cost Optimization pillar recommend adopting a consumption model to avoid over-provisioning?
What right-sizing and resource optimization practices does the Cost Optimization pillar specify for EC2 instances?
What are the core design principles of the Operational Excellence pillar and how do they relate to continuous improvement?
What does the Operational Excellence pillar say about runbooks, playbooks, and game days for operational readiness?
What sustainability design principles does the AWS Well-Architected Framework recommend to reduce environmental impact?
How does the Sustainability pillar recommend maximizing utilization and minimizing idle resources in cloud workloads?
How do the Security and Reliability pillars together recommend designing resilient, least-privilege architectures that can recover from security incidents?
How do I configure Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB multi-region replication and consistency levels?
What are the best practices for setting up Google Cloud BigQuery partitioned tables for cost savings?
How do I configure Kubernetes HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) with custom metrics using Prometheus?
What is the recommended Terraform module structure for managing multi-account AWS deployments using Terragrunt?
How do I fine-tune OpenAI GPT-4 on a custom dataset using the OpenAI API and best practices for prompt engineering?
